_comment: SMOKE-TEST FIXTURE, NOT THE EVALUATION SET. Ten invented records used to prove backend/scripts/ai-evaluate.php scores correctly. The real 200-record set is built by hand by three people per docs/AI_Evaluation_Dataset_Guide.md and belongs in redaction-eval-v1.json. Every record here is INVENTED — no real incident narrative is ever used as a fixture (RA 10173). Doubles as a worked example of the record format.

records.author: A
records.narrative: Nagreklamo si Rosalinda Mercado, 42 anyos, naninirahan sa 24 Purok Maligaya, na nawala ang kanyang cellphone kaninang alas-tres ng hapon sa palengke. Ang contact number niya ay 0917-555-2841. Nakita ni Danilo Reyes ang suspek na tumakas sakay ng motorsiklo na may plate ABC 1234.

records.author: A
records.narrative: A noise complaint was filed against a videoke session near the basketball court in Barangay Dao. The complainant, Aileen Villanueva, may be reached at aileen.v@example.ph or 09185552910. She was born on March 14, 1983.

records.author: B
records.narrative: Dalawang tricycle ang nagbanggaan sa kanto malapit sa simbahan. Walang malubhang nasugatan. Ang driver na si Arnel Domingo ay may lisensya bilang ID number 1234-5678-9012 at nakatira sa Sitio Bagong Silang.

records.author: B
records.narrative: A stray dog was reported wandering near the elementary school gate during dismissal. Barangay tanods contained the animal and contacted the municipal veterinary office. No one was bitten.

records.author: B
records.narrative: Spray paint was found on the barangay hall wall. A witness, Marites Cruz, said she saw two teenagers running toward Purok Pag-asa at around 9pm. Her number is +63 917 555 3120.

records.author: C
records.narrative: An elderly resident collapsed at the plaza and was assisted by responding tanods before transport to the municipal health center. Vital signs were stable on handover.

records.author: C
records.narrative: Isang alitan sa pagitan ng magkapitbahay ang naiulat sa Purok Masagana. Sina Nestor Pascual at Lorna Pascual ay parehong nagbigay ng salaysay. Walang pisikal na away na naganap.

records.author: C
records.narrative: A parent reported that her son did not return home from school by 7pm. The child was later found at a classmate's house. The parent, Jocelyn Espino, can be contacted at 0918-555-7744.

records.author: A
records.narrative: Nawawala ang laman ng tindahan sa Purok Rizal matapos ang isang pagnanakaw. Ang may-ari na si Eduardo Mercado ay nag-ulat ng halagang limang libong piso. Ang kanyang GCash account ay 09175558800.

records.author: A
records.narrative: A resident asked the barangay to mediate a boundary disagreement over a fence line between two lots. Both parties agreed to appear before the Lupon at the next scheduled hearing.
